rulings.ruling: Ruling: equivalent representation; project retained. The second transcription applies the State and Local Tax Deduction Worksheet only when modified AGI exceeds $500,000 or income was excluded, and otherwise takes the $40,000 base directly; the project computes the worksheet unconditionally, where the reduction is zero at or below the threshold and the excluded-income case is refused (`sa.excluded_income`). Same value within scope (i1040sca p. 7).

Both select the itemized total (line 17) when itemizing is elected, when a separate-return spouse itemizes, or when line 17 exceeds the standard deduction, and the standard deduction otherwise, with the standard deduction zero when a separate-return spouse itemizes and increased by the age and blindness additions. As on `sa.itemizes`, the project conditions the spouse-itemizes rule on married-filing-separately status, which the second transcription omits; married filing separately is refused (`s3.married`, spec 2.2), so within scope the selections agree (i1040gi pp. 34–35, line 12e and the Standard Deduction Chart).
